title.narrative: Resource Center for Women and Girls

description.narrative: "Resource Centre for Women and Girls is a girl and young women's rights organization with a mission to facilitate capacity building and awareness raising platforms for and with girls coming from rural areas in Machakos and across Eastern Kenya. The Equality Fund grant will support RCWG's core operational costs including salaries and the following activities: -Residential retreats where girls will have access to a space for exchange, mentoring and continued holistic support, outreach-to reach out and extend training and programming opportunities with partnering schools from hard to reach areas and communities through related school and community outreach. -Core operational costs to support the sustainability of the organization and long-term goals of the organization, including partial coverage of rent, salaries, and transportation -Awareness-building and marketing materials for education and promotion of activities among communities, girls and their families and supporters. -Accommodation for girls in crisis as a pilot project providing safe space and building on the frontline services of the help desk. -Staff capacity building for needed skills, e.g. website management, programme development document production."
